subject: Re: Kickoff: worst-case recall — decisions for close-out
body:
Team,

Decisions from today's review, ahead of the OKR lock next week:

1. The trainer integration ships with TWO presets: "balanced" (the logit-adjusted baseline) and "worst-case" (Algorithm 1 with Umar's damped multiplier updates). The 0.12 → 0.41 worst-case recall result is the headline, and offering the milder preset answers the average-accuracy objection without a custom-config support burden.
2. Umar's damping lands in the defaults; the 15% epoch overhead is acceptable and we document it.
3. Paloma confirmed the v2 re-registration of the long-tail tfrecords completed 06-09, so we're fully clear of the Corpus freeze and Q3 retraining is unblocked.
4. Q3 OKR filed: worst-case preset adopted by 2 platform customers, with a published trade-off note.

Readout on 06-25; window closes clean on 06-29. Thanks all.

Dmitri
